name: hearthroom
description: Open role-card community: registry, search and ranking (Cloudflare Workers + D1)

scripts.typecheck: wrangler types && tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test -w web
scripts.build: npm run build:stage && npm run build -w web
scripts.predeploy: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.build:stage: npm --prefix stage ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix stage run build:stage
